C3-01-freshwater-ecological-zones-cross

Cross-section of a freshwater pond showing the four ecological groups. At the surface: pond skaters standing on the water film, mosquito larvae hanging under the surface, and floating duckweed. In the open water: tiny green phytoplankton dots and small zooplankton (water fleas, Cyclops) drawn enlarged in a circle, and swimming Tilapia and a frog. On the muddy bottom: snails, worms, a dragonfly nymph and rooted plants. Brackets on the side mark each zone. Soft blues, greens and browns.
C3-02-pond-community-habitat-cross

Cross-section of a Nigerian pond with its plants and animals. Edge: sedges and Typha bulrushes rooted in mud, a frog on the bank, a kingfisher on a branch. Surface: a water lily with round floating leaves on long stalks and a flower, floating water lettuce rosettes with hanging roots, duckweed, a pond skater, mosquito larvae hanging with siphons at the surface. Under water: submerged feathery hornwort, green Spirogyra filaments, tadpoles, water fleas, a water boatman, a dragonfly nymph, Tilapia, a water snail on a stem, Hydra attached to a leaf. Bottom: dark mud with a catfish and worms. Soft blues, greens and browns.
C3-03-hydrophyte-leaf-anatomical-adaptations

Two panels showing adaptations of hydrophytes. Left: a water lily leaf and its stalk, with a cut-away of the leaf showing stomata only on the upper surface and large air spaces in the leaf and stalk. Right: a water lettuce plant with a rosette of thick, ridged, hairy leaves floating on the surface and long feathery roots hanging below, with a cut-away of a leaf showing spongy air-filled tissue. Soft greens and blues.
C3-05-deep-lake-ecological-zones

Cross-section of a deep lake showing its zones. Left side: a shallow sloping shore with reeds, papyrus and water lilies (littoral zone). Surface water across the middle with phytoplankton dots and zooplankton, Tilapia and a Nile perch (limnetic zone). Below it, darker deep water with no plants (profundal zone), with dead material drifting down. The muddy bottom with bacteria and midge larvae (benthic zone). A pelican on the surface and a fishing canoe. Light rays penetrating only the upper water. Shades of blue getting darker with depth, greens at the shore.
C3-06-rocky-seashore-zonation-profile

Side view of a rocky seashore sloping down from the land on the left to the sea on the right, with horizontal bands marking the zones and two lines for high-tide and low-tide levels. Splash zone at the top with lichens and periwinkles. Upper shore with barnacles and periwinkles. Middle shore with limpets, mussels, oysters and green sea lettuce. Lower shore with sea anemones, starfish, sea urchins, crabs and red and brown seaweeds with holdfasts. Sublittoral zone below the low-tide line with large brown seaweed (Sargassum with air bladders) and fish. A rock pool in the middle shore with a small fish. Soft blues, greys, greens and browns.
C3-07-mangrove-swamp-ecosystem-cross

A Niger Delta mangrove swamp at low tide, side view with a cut-away of the mud. Left: a red mangrove (Rhizophora) with arching stilt roots growing from its trunk into the mud, oysters attached to the roots, and long green spear-like propagules hanging from its branches, with one fallen propagule stuck upright in the mud. Right: a white mangrove (Avicennia) with many pencil-like pneumatophores sticking up out of the mud from horizontal roots beneath, with small dots of lenticels and tiny white salt crystals on its leaves. On the mud: mudskippers with eyes on top of their heads propped on their pectoral fins, a fiddler crab with one huge claw beside its burrow, periwinkle snails. A heron in the shallow water. The cut-away shows dark grey anaerobic mud. Soft greens, greys and browns.
C3-08-tropical-rainforest-canopy

The canopy of a Nigerian rainforest tree with branches covered in epiphytes and animals. Show: an epiphytic orchid with white aerial roots and a flower on a branch; a staghorn fern clasping the trunk; mosses and lichens on bark; a woody liana climbing up; a mona monkey with long limbs and a long tail holding a fruit; a chameleon on a twig gripping with zygodactylous feet, its tail coiled around the twig and its long tongue catching an insect; a tree frog with round toe pads on a leaf; a hornbill eating fruit; an anomalure gliding between trees with its skin membrane spread; weaver ants on a leaf nest. Soft greens, browns and touches of colour.
C3-09-savanna-field-ecosystem-landscape

A dry grassy savanna field in Nigeria in the early dry season, with an abandoned farm patch in the foreground. Show: tall tufts of grass (some turning yellow), spear grass with a cut-away showing its underground rhizome, a shea tree with thick corky bark and a baobab with a fat trunk in the background, Tridax weeds with fluffy seed heads, a termite mound, a green grasshopper on a grass blade, a brown variegated grasshopper, an Agama lizard on a rock, a grasscutter in the grass, a rat at a burrow entrance, a hawk flying overhead, a cattle egret beside a grazing cow. Soft yellows, greens and browns.
C3-10-soil-subterranean-burrows-cross

Cut-away side view of the soil under a savanna field showing several burrows. A giant pouched rat in a nest chamber at the end of a long tunnel with stored food; an earthworm in a narrow tunnel with its segments and bristles shown in an enlarged circle; a mole cricket with spade-like front legs digging; a millipede and a centipede in leaf litter; a toad buried in the soil; a snake entering a hole; plant roots running through the soil; fungi growing on dead matter. On the surface: grass and a burrow entrance. Soft browns and greys with green grass on top.
C3-04-stream-ecosystem-profile-cross

Cross-section of a fast-flowing stream with water arrows showing the current. Large stones on the bottom covered in a thin green layer of algae, with mosses on a rock at the edge. On and under the stones: a flattened mayfly nymph, a caddisfly larva in a case made of small stones, blackfly larvae attached by their hind ends with fan-like mouth brushes, a freshwater limpet clamped to a rock, a flatworm, a freshwater crab hiding under a stone. A small fish facing upstream. Trees on the bank dropping leaves. Soft blues, greys and greens.
